name: Schrodinger's Gambit
author: Agent15
summary: If any of your phantom pieces is threatened, it becomes default.
description: At the start of each of your turns, every phantom piece of yours that an enemy is threatening loses its phantom state and turns back into a normal piece. A rare gambit that mixes Crybaby's threat scan with Necromancer's phantom reset. Needs the Gambit Creation API, which installs automatically.
